visibility_changes: Fin front plane Y=-21.95 and fin X widths are retained; backing infill replaces the air behind four fins with solid ribs, changing fin side/rear surfaces and oblique visibility of window recesses. It is a deliberate manufacturing simplification, not a claim of architectural accuracy.

Rear 0.05 mm-deep by 0.10 mm-high microgap is filled only behind original sill lower lip; 0.05 mm local-Y extension beyond cut backplane overlaps solid, and 0.01 mm overlap at sill avoids a coincident join. This changes microgap internal surfaces while leaving the projecting front sill edge/local Y=-13 unchanged.

Equal bounding boxes or limited crops do not prove all visible contour views are unchanged. Actual added/removed bounds, fixed rays, bay volume crops and prescribed source-parameter residuals are given above.
limitations: Finite fixed rays and slices do not certify a global thickness minimum or full support extraction.
Any nonzero float32 export/Boolean residual is retained, even if below the declared comparison tolerance.
This variant only removes the specified fin-back air and sill microgap. Remaining eaves, grille, arcade, windows, 0.8 mm details and roof edge support/toolpath risks persist.
No claim of success on arbitrary single-material FDM equipment; actual slicing, support strategy and test printing remain outstanding.
